headline: US and Iran trade strikes across the Gulf
source: Reuters, via Just Security and Drop Site
pages: US fighter jets struck an Iranian missile-launch site on Qeshm Island on Tuesday, a US official told Reuters. The strike followed Iranian attacks on US personnel and assets in the region. Early Wednesday, Iran's military said it launched drones at US Patriot systems at Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait, and Kuwait reported incoming drones. Bahrain sounded missile alerts twice before dawn. In the Strait of Hormuz, a vessel operated by ADNOC Logistics and Services was attacked Tuesday evening, leaving one crew member missing and 11 injured, the company said. Iran's navy said three vessels hit naval mines there, and Iran claimed it shot down a US MQ-9 drone.

Secretary of State Marco Rubio said he sees no imminent threat to Washington after a CNN report about a possible Iranian plot, which Iran rejected. The fighting threatens shipping through a key oil route.
Source: Reuters, via Just Security and Drop Site
